---
title: Releasing
guide-section: Development
---

## Checks

```sh
uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright
```

CI runs these on every push and pull request.

## Versions

Every change bumps the dev version in `pyproject.toml`, e.g. `0.1.0.9003` to `0.1.0.9004`:

```sh
uv version 0.1.0.9004
```

## Release

```sh
uv run release dev                              # tag the current dev version, vX.Y.Z.9NNN
uv run release prod [patch|minor|major|X.Y.Z]   # release vX.Y.Z, default patch
```

Both run the checks, push the tag, wait for CI, then run your config repo's deploy workflow for the tag and wait for it. Dev tags deploy with *dev* set. See [Deploy](deploy.qmd).

`prod` also moves the `## [Unreleased]` section of `CHANGELOG.md` to the new version, sets the version and commits `chore: release vX.Y.Z` to `main`. Once CI and the deploy succeed, it deletes the dev tags before the release. If it stops early, delete them later with `uv run release prune-dev-tags`.

| option | meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show the version, changes and deploy, and change nothing |
| `--no-deploy` | push the tag but do not run the deploy workflow |
| `--force` | redeploy even if the box runs this tag |
| `-y` | do not ask for confirmation |

The deploy workflow runs in the repo set by `CONFIG_REPO` (environment or `.deploy.env`), default `<owner>/ha-automations-config`. CI checks that the tag matches the `pyproject.toml` version.

Commits are one-line conventional commits.

## Docs

```sh
uv sync --group docs
uv run great-docs preview
```

Building needs [Quarto](https://quarto.org). The site deploys to GitHub Pages on each push to `main`.
